mechanism: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

hypothesis.mechanism: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist
context_requirements: Functional GABAA receptor expression (pentameric subunits including a benzodiazepine-sensitive alpha subunit and gamma2)
Neuronal lineage or exogenous expression of GABAA receptor subunits
Membrane potential and chloride gradient permitting GABA-gated chloride conductance
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of GABA-receptor or neuronal gene expression signatures after treatment
Shared transcriptional response across multiple lines that is absent in GABAA-receptor-negative controls
